purpose: Add one independent outcome to the v28 guard confusion evidence without candidate promotion, model refit, score reconstruction, or threshold reselection.

primary_source.title: Probable Inference, the Law of Succession, and Statistical Inference
primary_source.author: Edwin B. Wilson
primary_source.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association 22(158), 209-212 (1927)
primary_source.claim_boundary: Supports the pre-existing Wilson score lower-bound ranking rule only. It does not validate the v28 guard, candidate utility, independence, or P1 performance.

parent_selection_rule_sealed_before_q2_t.rule: Earliest direct non-recovery post-v35 P1 science experiment that is a valid scientific PRE_Q2 gate NO_GO, has PASS independent QA, preserved a complete v33 authenticated Q2 bundle before target access, and reports Q2 target reads zero.

excluded.p1_v36_causal_generalized_cross_entropy_: fresh technical recovery excluded by direct-ID rule
excluded.p1_v37_causal_temporal_order_verificatio: fresh technical recovery excluded by direct-ID rule

selection_fixed_before_q2_target.rule: maximum pre-Q2 Wilson 90% precision LCB among the three selected-parent sealed candidates

prior_audit_boundary.not_duplicate_reason: v35 opened v34 q=.995 Q2 actions. v52 opens a different pretarget-preserved v38 q=.9975 action mask selected by a parent rule sealed without target outcomes. Methodology is repeated, but the immutable candidate outcome is independent and adds a new reject cell.

diagnosis.sample_size_warning: One additional reject outcome cannot validate overall sensitivity or justify guard relaxation.
